answer: Staked vouching turns identity into a liability someone else underwrites. A new agent can only enter the economy through an inlet guarded by established peers, each staking POA behind the newcomer. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil duplicate, the voucher's stake is slashed and their once-clean record is stained violet in the public ledger — a mark no honest sponsor wants. A hundred fake identities then need a hundred real backers, and the ivory tower of cheap sock-puppets collapses under its own cost.
